      "observations": [
        "All 1,022 owned diff lines across nine paths were read, including the complete new 129-line xpcshell file, the new component capture cases, and the complete 333-added/7-removed integration-test changes. This is the initial Exchange type submission/capture/backend phase; later5829 prefill mapping and5830 advanced navigation remain separate owned entries.",
        "The component stores an AccountConfig and captureState copies it, chooses the selected EWS/Graph card, sets source/type/hostname/443/SSL/auth/username and a service URL, then resets or constructs the custom OAuth object. The initial EWS capture preserves a supplied exchangeURL or uses its default; Graph uses its fixed default. The accepted capture later derives hostname from the already supplied config URL and permits an unselected auth value. Those changes are not projected backward.",
        "Input/change handlers and initialization call #checkFormValidity, which dispatches config-updated with current completed state. The parent disables/enables Forward from that field. The new JSDoc says whenever validity changes, but neither the owned nor accepted helper compares against a previous validity value; it dispatches when called. A summary that names those calls/current validity would describe the actual contract more precisely without implying deduplication.",
        "The same exported applyExchangeOAuthSettings helper is called for the temporary verification server before verifyLogon and for the final incoming server before valid=true. It returns early unless useCustomDetails is true and the incoming type is ews/graph, then queries IExchangeIncomingServer and sets override, client/application ID and tenant. It does not assign the config object's derived endpoint strings directly in this helper.",
        "The actual native receiver was inspected in both phases. The owned GetDetailsForHostname calls ForTypeAndHostname(type, hostname), while the accepted helper additionally gets username and calls ForAccount(type, hostname, username). Native string-property macros and the Boolean accessor route through that helper. This checks lookup inputs and forwarding; it does not establish all cache/isolation or provider/network semantics. The accepted Boolean macro differs from the original setter and is kept as later source.",
        "Component assertions directly check Graph capture, custom OAuth fields/endpoints and an EWS password capture. The two xpcshell tasks directly check an EWS server's custom properties and a newly created EWS account's type/auth/URL/custom values. They use one synthetic account case each and do not directly assert two-account independence, default-override clearing, Graph account creation or successful OAuth token acquisition.",
        "The new browser tasks cover entry through Microsoft service settings to the password step, then an EWS account-creation scenario using the actual ServerTestUtils EWS fixture factory and an HTTP test URL with an explicit local lint exception. The task waits for server-loaded account discovery and the success subview, then asserts account/identity fields. It is a test definition, not a run performed here or a live Microsoft connection. Some manual-config activations change from synthesized pointer input to click(), so those sites are not direct pointer-accessibility checks.",
        "Every added direct assertion and the new helper-driven assertion use has a nonempty expected-behavior message. Existing try/finally cleanup in authored tests is recorded as the patch's actual harness shape; the user guidance against writing new test try/finally is not applied as a defect criterion to this author's patch. No source edit, account/OAuth operation, network, browser, build, lint or test was run.",
        "Complete primary/own review coverage is inherited from Parent/C with original IDs, readers and times. The six actual inlines and relevant full-flow/same-host bodies were checked only as needed for source adoption; no duplicate independent full read is claimed.",
        "The actual username JSDoc uses AccountHubInput, and the owned setState assumes its supplied config/incoming object exists while treating oauthSettings as optional. The full CreateInBackend-focused test is placed in xpcshell, matching that placement request. Done alone is not the adoption proof.",
        "The reviewer asks for OAuth integration/full account creation. The owned browser end-to-end case instead selects passwordCleartext against the EWS fixture, while component tests capture Graph/custom OAuth fields and xpcshell asserts custom OAuth properties on an EWS account. These are useful different test scopes, but they do not directly demonstrate an OAuth browser/token flow.",
        "The reviewer reports that custom settings appear to affect other accounts using the same hostname, accepts the one-account path and explicitly assigns the other-account issue to a separate follow-up. That is an attributed historical result, not a new reproduction. The owned native lookup's type/hostname inputs and accepted username argument are checked separately; they do not prove all isolation semantics.",
        "The URL question is deferred in discussion to D310559 and a later comment proposes stripping the defaults there. This selected capture still uses the EWS supplied-or-default URL and a fixed Graph default. The actually read5829 delta changes type/auth prefill and does not remove capture's default-URL logic; the accepted final capture is a later phase.",
        "Historical Try, account identifiers, application IDs, tenant details and test claims stay in private originals. No browser, OAuth request, account creation, native profile, test or linked dependency was run here."
      ],
